1.w: For the music director, according to the alumoth-labben style; a psalm of David. I will thank the Lord with all my heart! I will tell about all your amazing deeds.

2.w: I will be happy and rejoice in you. I will sing praises to you, O Most High.

3.w: When my enemies turn back, they trip and are defeated before you.

4.w: For you defended my just cause; from your throne you pronounced a just decision.

5.w: You terrified the nations with your battle cry. You destroyed the wicked; you permanently wiped out all memory of them.

6.w: The enemy’s cities have been reduced to permanent ruins. You destroyed their cities; all memory of the enemies has perished.

7.w: But the Lord rules forever; he reigns in a just manner.

8.w: He judges the world fairly; he makes just legal decisions for the nations.

9.w: Consequently the Lord provides safety for the oppressed; he provides safety in times of trouble.

10.w: Your loyal followers trust in you, for you, Lord , do not abandon those who seek your help.

11.w: Sing praises to the Lord , who rules in Zion. Tell the nations what he has done.

12.w: For the one who takes revenge against murderers took notice of the oppressed; he did not overlook their cry for help

13.w: when they prayed: “Have mercy on me, Lord ! See how I am oppressed by those who hate me, O one who can snatch me away from the gates of death!

14.w: Then I will tell about all your praiseworthy acts; in the gates of Daughter Zion I will rejoice because of your deliverance.”

15.w: The nations fell into the pit they had made; their feet were caught in the net they had hidden.

16.w: The Lord revealed himself; he accomplished justice. The wicked were ensnared by their own actions. ( Higgaion . Selah )

17.w: The wicked are turned back and sent to Sheol; this is the destiny of all the nations that ignore God,

18.w: for the needy are not permanently ignored, the hopes of the oppressed are not forever dashed.

19.w: Rise up, Lord ! Don’t let men be defiant. May the nations be judged in your presence.

20.w: Terrify them, Lord . Let the nations know they are mere mortals. (Selah)
